name: Gel
tagline: Soft sea-glass tonal surfaces, glass where layers float, and corners that flow like water.
description: A whole cmux look built only from public surfaces: one seed color's tonal palette for light and dark in a theme file, Roboto and roomy rows in settings, filled tonal containers with large soft corners and no hairlines in a stylesheet of cmux.agentPane.style/1 tokens, and a hover card of tonal chips on glass. Remove it and everything you had comes back.
